:::{#def-operator}
#### Operator

An **operator** is a [function](#def-function)
whose [arguments](#def-argument) and [values](#def-value)
are both functions or both vectors.

Some authors call every function an operator,
and others reserve the word for functions whose domain and codomain are the same set,
as in the [linear operator](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-linear-operator).

:::
